preconditions.description: The size of the input array n is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each value in the function f is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (1 <= m <= 10**6 and len(g) == n and len(h) == m)
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no solution, or consists of m, g, and h with valid lengths.

postconditions.expression: all(g[h[x]] == x for x in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: The composition g(h(x)) equals x for all x in [m].

postconditions.expression: all(h[g[x]] == f[x] for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The composition h(g(x)) equals f(x) for all x in [n].
